notes: Prospective, observational, single-arm multicentre cohort (IDEAL): one FAc implant at baseline (regimen single).
Inclusion required persistent DME despite treatment with available therapies, so both subgroups are previously treated.
Visits were held approximately at the stated months after the FAc injection according to clinical routine (Methods); the nominal months 12 and 24 are used.
Missing values were not replaced (Methods): observed cases; the eye counts at 12 and 24 months are lower than at baseline (ordinary attrition, no minimum follow-up criterion).
Adjunctive intravitreal therapy (anti-VEGF, dexamethasone or a second FAc implant) was recorded in part of the eyes during the 24 months; values were not removed or replaced after it.
The baseline n of each Table 2 partition sums to fewer than the 214 eyes of Table 1 (factor not recorded for some eyes).
A linear mixed-effects model was used for testing; the tabulated values are descriptive means ± SD.
Central macular thickness (Table 3), IOP and cataract events are not extracted.
